name: CCW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top title, won by Dazz from Tommy Gunn in a steel cage match at the promotion's own first pay-per-view.

name: CCW X-Treme Championship
epitaph: Contested inside Hell in a Cell at the promotion's own first pay-per-view, changing hands from Doctor Pain to "The Franchise" Reon Wilson.

name: CCW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Won by The Dark Alliance from The Specialists at the promotion's own first pay-per-view, amid the kidnapping of a rival manager.

name: CCW International Championship
epitaph: First awarded at the promotion's own first pay-per-view, in a tournament final decided when the promotion's own president forced a controversial count.

name: CCW World Television Championship
epitaph: Defended by Axl Blaze against Alex Libido at the promotion's own first pay-per-view, in a match fought above a cage suspending the challenger's own wife.
